periods.label: Sat 12 Sep
periods.text: North to northwesterly below 10 knots tending north to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the morning. Winds reaching up to 20 knots north of Moruya Heads during the afternoon and evening. Below 0.5 metres, increasing to around 1 metre during the morning. Southerly 1.5 to 2 metres. Mostly sunny.

periods.label: Sun 13 Sep

periods.label: Mon 14 Sep

Southerly 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning. Northeasterly around 1 metre. Partly cloudy. 50% chance of showers.

periods.label: Sat 12 Sep
periods.text: Southeasterly 10 to 15 knots. Around 1 metre. South to southeasterly 1.5 to 2 metres. Northeast to southeasterly around 1 metre north of Yamba, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres later in the evening. Partly cloudy. 60% chance of showers. Surf conditions may be more powerful than they appear and are expected to be hazardous for coastal activities such as crossing bars by boat and rock fishing.

periods.label: Sun 13 Sep

Southeasterly 1 to 1.5 metres inshore, increasing to 1.5 to 2 metres offshore south of Cape Byron. Southeasterly 1 to 1.5 metres north of Yamba, tending northeast to southeasterly around 1 metre during the morning. Partly cloudy.

periods.label: Mon 14 Sep

Southeasterly around 1 metre inshore, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore north of Yamba. Mostly sunny.
